purpose: Falsify three new daily cross-sectional mechanisms not previously tested in Discovery v2 Sprints 1-4.

data.survivorship_warning: Fixed present liquid universe; historical results do not remove survivorship risk.

execution.execution: next available UTC daily open after signal

donchian_channel_position_continuation.hypothesis: A completed close positioned unusually high or low relative to its strictly prior price channel predicts next-day continuation in the same direction.
donchian_channel_position_continuation.prior_channel: highest high and lowest low over the strictly prior N completed bars t-N through t-1
donchian_channel_position_continuation.score: 2 * (close_t - prior_low) / (prior_high - prior_low) - 1, with invalid zero-width channels excluded
donchian_channel_position_continuation.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores

amihud_liquidity_premium.hypothesis: Cross-sectional differences in recent return-per-dollar-volume illiquidity predict next-day relative returns after costs and funding.
amihud_liquidity_premium.daily_illiquidity: abs(close_t / close_t-1 - 1) divided by max(close_t * base_asset_volume_t, positive epsilon)
amihud_liquidity_premium.score: mean daily illiquidity across the most recent N completed bars ending at t
amihud_liquidity_premium.direction: long the two lowest-illiquidity symbols and short the two highest-illiquidity symbols

close_location_pressure.hypothesis: Persistent closes near the high or low of the completed daily range proxy directional buying or selling pressure that continues into the next daily open-to-open period.
close_location_pressure.daily_close_location: (2*close_t - high_t - low_t) / (high_t - low_t), with zero-range bars excluded
close_location_pressure.score: mean completed daily close-location value across the most recent N bars ending at t
close_location_pressure.direction: long highest two scores and short lowest two scores

family_falsification_gate.selection_if_family_passes: Among variants belonging to an adjacent 1.5x-cost-positive neighborhood, select the upper median parameter; never select by maximum PnL.

evidence_boundary.positive_sprint_result_only_allows: new frozen candidate followed by independent-engine reproduction and D2/D3/D4 evidence
